Śaiśirīyaśikṣā
or Śākhālakṣaṇa. veda. a treatise on phonetics in about 175 verses. by Śaiśira Muni, disciple of Śaunaka.
See Aithal, Vedic Ancilary Lit. p.. 600-01. 618-19.
